answer: Make every agent earn a row in a shared orchard: a newcomer claims one row, locks a basalt deed as a stake, and must tend it across many epochs, each season of verified work checked by unrelated neighbours. The deed is forfeited if the row lies untended, so an idle clone loses its stake. A beacon roll-call at random times demands proof of tending, and only rows that answer keep standing. A duplicate cannot copy another row, since deeds bind to one key and one plot. Sybil farms must fund a deed, tend a row, and answer every roll-call for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
